Purpose of This Website

This website presents information about Makeup Academy Manila's courses and accepts inquiries. It is not an enrollment contract, and submitting an inquiry does not reserve a slot.

Course Information

Course names, durations, tuition, curricula, inclusions, certificates, welcome gifts, succeeding-course discounts, portfolio references, industry techniques, and on-the-job training notes published here come from the academy's official 2026 course posters. Where a poster does not include a detail, we do not present one. Schedules are maintained by staff and shared through direct inquiry.

Enrollment, Payment, and Cancellation

Enrollment is completed directly with our admissions team. Payment terms, reservation rules, and cancellation or refund conditions will be published here once confirmed by operations. Until then, ask us directly for the current policy before paying anything.

Results Disclaimer

Our courses teach skills through structured, face-to-face training. We do not guarantee employment, income, bookings, or any specific career outcome. Student work shown on this site is shared with permission and reflects individual effort and practice.

Intellectual Property

The Makeup Academy Manila name, logo, course materials, and website content belong to the academy. Course outlines and posters may not be reproduced without written permission. Student portfolios remain the work of the students who created them.

Liability

To the extent permitted by Philippine law, Makeup Academy Manila is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of this website or reliance on its content. Our total liability for any claim related to this website will not exceed the amount you paid us, if anything. For in-person training, separate enrollment terms apply once you register with our admissions team.
